summary: Original South Quay open-world slice: drive 8 vehicles through live traffic and crowds, take 4 story jobs and 3 activities, and outrun an evidence-based 5-tier Alert police system, with saves, map/GPS/phone and day-to-night — all procedural, no external assets.
notes: Custom deterministic 2.5D physics instead of Rapier (documented). Story missions 2-4 verified via graph/runtime tests, not hand-played in a browser. Browser checks were scripted headless Edge; no interactive mouse-look playtest. npm audit flags dev-only vitest deps.
